items.title: Generate And Verify OpenAPI From Quarkus
items.description: Intermediate tutorial for documenting a Quarkus provider, exporting its contract, and preventing implementation-to-contract drift.

items.title: Generate, Package, And Consume Quarkus OpenAPI Clients
items.description: Advanced tutorial for generated Quarkus REST clients, Maven contract artifacts, compatibility gates, security, and release operations.

items.title: OpenAPI Contracts And Generated DTO Artifacts
items.description: A contract-first retail tutorial for defining checkout APIs, generating Java DTOs with Gradle Kotlin DSL, publishing versioned artifacts, and consuming them from Quarkus projects.

items.title: OpenAPI Fundamentals For Quarkus
items.description: Beginner tutorial explaining OpenAPI, Swagger UI, contracts, schemas, operations, and a first Quarkus API description.
